description: F1 race quality scoring schema — v2

manual.label: Lead Battle
manual.description: Quality and duration of fight for race lead (0 = processional, 100 = wheel-to-wheel throughout)

manual.label: First Lap Drama
manual.description: Incidents, position changes, and incident density on lap 1

manual.label: Midfield Action
manual.description: Sustained battles and overtakes in P6–P15

manual.label: Strategy Variety
manual.description: Divergence in pit strategy across front-running teams

manual.label: Weather Impact
manual.description: Degree to which changing or wet conditions shaped the race

manual.label: Championship Stakes
manual.description: Importance of this race to the drivers' and constructors' championships

manual.label: Fan Sentiment
manual.description: Overall crowd / viewer sentiment toward race quality (post-race polls, social tone)

manual.label: TV Direction
manual.description: Quality of broadcast — whether battles were shown in real time

auto.label: Finishing Gap (P1–P5)
auto.description: Total gap between P1 and P5 at the finish

auto.label: Overtakes for Position
auto.description: Number of on-track overtakes for race position (exc. pit-cycle swaps)

auto.label: Retirements
auto.description: Number of classified retirements (mechanical or incident)

auto.label: Safety Car Deployments
auto.description: Full Safety Car and Virtual Safety Car periods combined

auto.label: Reddit Sentiment Score
auto.description: Normalised 0–100 sentiment score derived from r/formula1 race thread

season_dominance.description: Reduces effective score ceiling linearly. At win_rate=1.0 the ceiling is 85. Applied as: ceiling = 100 - (rate * max_ceiling_penalty).

overrides.label: Red Flag Race
overrides.description: Any race interrupted by a red flag is guaranteed at least 62

overrides.label: Poor Direction + Low Sentiment
overrides.description: When TV direction AND fan sentiment are both poor, cap the score at 55

overrides.label: Championship Decider
overrides.description: Title-deciding races always clear the highlights threshold

overrides.label: Sprint Weekend Penalty
overrides.description: Sprint weekends run abbreviated practice; slight quality discount applied

confidence.description: Fraction of total signal weight that was actually supplied. < low_max → low; < medium_max → medium; else → high.
